summary: Dolphin Drift Charge maxBoostMultiplier 2.259 -> 2.82 (+25%, the cap), step 5 of the elemental loop for Regatta.
why: The Dolphin is the slow end of the six. Real-game judge, 17 archive2 courses x 3 seeds: L5 95.7 -> 76.3 s (every seed faster), card 107.2 -> 102.8 s (inside its seed noise). Switchback (AI, seeds 1-3) stays inside the rung bars but the AI is slower with the bigger boost on I2/I3: I1 92 -> 86, I2 118 -> 130, I3 119 -> 132, I4 255 -> 255 s; a Dolphin retrain at the new boost would likely win that back.
